verdict.rationale: Docs mention only one official SDK — a React component library with built-in business logic — but there's no evidence of broader multi-language official SDKs (e.g., Python, Node, Ruby) typical for API-first platforms; the rest of the evidence describes raw REST API endpoints, webhooks, and pagination rather than SDK tooling. Missing for 10: multi-language official SDK offerings, SDK versioning/changelog docs, and community corroboration of SDK usage.
